HTTP response count by code
chart.programText:
D = data('http/server/response_count', filter=filter('response_code', '5*'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['project_id']).publish(label='D')
B = data('http/server/response_count', filter=filter('response_code', '3*'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['project_id']).publish(label='B')
C = data('http/server/response_count', filter=filter('response_code', '4*'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['project_id']).publish(label='C')
A = data('http/server/response_count', filter=filter('response_code', '2*'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['project_id']).publish(label='A')

chart.name: Cached vs non-cached responses
chart.programText:
A = data('http/server/response_style_count', filter=filter('cached', 'false'),rollup='rate').sum(by=['version_id']).publish(label='A')
C = data('http/server/response_style_count', filter=filter('cached', 'true')).sum(by=['version_id']).publish(label='C')
